newsitem.title: INDIA: Market conditions ripe for India bond issue - SBICAP.
newsitem.headline: Market conditions ripe for India bond issue - SBICAP.

text.p: Good liquidity with banks and high demand for government securities offer ideal conditions for the Indian government to tap the money market, SBI Capital Markets (SBICAP) said in a debt market study on Tuesday.
"With 10-year paper trading below 12 percent, it is time to set a fresh benchmark (for long bonds) as appetite for paper at the long end of the curve is also good," SBICAP said.
It said the current easy liquidity and a sustained rise in gilt prices could be sufficient reason for the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to announce a bond auction in the next fortnight.
The report also said a fresh bond issue will drain some of the rupees released by the RBI's forex market intervention.
The central bank has been buying dollars for more than six months in a bid to stem the rupee's rise against the U.S. currency.
The rupee has been buoyant against the dollar on poor demand for the greenback and strong supplies through foreign portfolio investments and external commercial borrowing by Indian firms.
SBICAP said liquidity with the banking system is good and will not be affected by a fresh issue of government bonds.
